summary: Fact: TTI's FY25 10-K, accession 0000844965-26-000015, Note 15 Income Taxes, page F-35, states a 4.99 percent tax-plan trigger. DEF 14A accession 0000844965-26-000026 states the same figure. This is not a Section 382 dollar limit.
